QuestInfo.name: [Title] Bully
QuestInfo.0: There seems to be special title that can only be obtained in Battle Mode. Go to Maximus the knight and find out what that is.
QuestInfo.1: If you participate in Battle Mode for at least 10 days consistently and receive a Gallant Emblem, you can obtain the #bBully#k title, title reserved for those who truly enjoying fighting. \n\n#rTip: Your Gallant Gauge must be spent on a Gallant Emblem to get your participation in Battle Mode acknowledged.
QuestInfo.2: You received a title from Maximus.

0.0: You here for Battle Mode? Thinking about trying out for some of those #btitles#k?
0.1: There are all kinds of titles you can get in Battle Mode. You ever see anybody with a #bBully#k title? That's for the people that really like to throw around their weight.
0.2: If you come back to Battle Mode for 10 days and get a Gallant Emblem each day, I'll let you push around the newbies as a #bBully#k. What do you say?

yes.0: You're gonna do just fine in Battle Mode. Take on the challenge and show us what you can do.

no.0: Not into glory and fame and being recognized as the best, huh? Can't say I'm surprised...

1.0: This is it! You're officially a #bBully#k now! Go push those newcomers around to toughen 'em up!

default.0: Come back to Battle Mode for 10 days and get your Gallant Emblems each day... I'll let you be a #bBully#k if you do.
